items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: You know Wynton Marsalis was with Blakey towards the end.

ctx.x: It’s almost like it could have been the Art Blakey jazz school too.
It was. And it became that. You know Wynton Marsalis was with Blakey towards the end.
And Wayne Shorter and all those guys.
